items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ethyl Waters played the TOBA, right? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't think so.

ctx.x: No. We're coming out of the -- that's Stopping the Traffic. And they put the man in the hospital and we went on to Chicago, St. Louis and then back to Chicago and on to Pittsburgh, and you know, the route, the TOBA circuit. Now, let me say, after I come out with Duke, see, in '40.

Name me some acts back in the -- now, we're back in the '20s. Before we get to the '40s, that's 20 years, we can just -- while we're in the '20s, on the TOBA circuit. Name me some of the acts all in there. Ethyl Waters played the TOBA, right?
